{{Quote|Dex's Diner	is the proud winner of three monosaccharide ribbons from the Tri-System Sugary Mass Bake-Off. You can't go wrong with	desserts like these.|Dex's Diner menu|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
A '''monosaccharide ribbon''' was an award given at the [[Tri-System Sugary Mass Bake-Off]] competition. [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was the proud winner of three monosaccharide ribbons which the diner's menu used to prompt their favorite desserts section that included [[zoochberry cobbler]], [[Kubindian royal jelly roll]], and [[sticky sweetmallow square]]s.<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Monosaccharide ribbons were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
